messages:
devon: quick sync — interactive endpoints (short chat) hitting p95 regressions when tenant budgets are applied. need a minimal contract between admission and quota to preserve latency SLOs without duplicating fairness.

anya: +1. two options: quota gives an "effective_budget" per request, or quota returns candidate leases and admission/runtime choose. which reduces coupling?

frank: vote for candidate leases (ordered). centralize policy in quota service, admission stays a simple gate. include small hints so runtime can batch correctly.

liam: agree but add lightweight metadata so admission can prefer short-chat leases (no heavy logic).

devon: proposed lease pointer fields: lease_id, capacity_tokens, latency_budget_ms, tier, min_batch_size, max_tail_tokens, probation(bool), outstanding_credit_limit. keep it minimal.

anya: add abuse_score_threshold and trace_hint for quick tagging. telemetry must include leases_checked, lease_chosen, pre_charge_capacity, post_charge_capacity, decision, trace_id.

frank: behavior on quota timeout: deterministic fallback -> emergency per-route lease (low cap, high cost). admission allowed to use it. no silent fail-open.

liam: charge semantics: admission picks lease and returns token to runtime. runtime reports charge async. quota should return outstanding_credit_limit; if admitting would exceed it, deny.

devon: async charge = temporary overspend OK if bounded. we need a bound on outstanding uncharged tokens per tenant and alerts for runaway.

anya: runtime hints: min_batch_size and max_tail_tokens so batching respects p95. probation flag = fast soft-degrade.

frank: add fallback_model_hint and max_output_tokens_hint for automated cheaper-model reroutes.

sre-bot: deploy:rate-service v2 -> staging (feature flag lease_vectors=on)

devon: plan: enable for 3 canary tenants with varied SLAs for 24h, collect p50/p95 and fairness deltas. regression rule: if p95 > 20% degrade auto-disable.

liam: I'll orchestrate canary and metrics collection.

anya: I'll add e2e test for telemetry chain + unit sim for quota timeout -> fallback.

frank: I'll write a short RFC with schema, failure modes, telemetry fields and sample trace.

devon: keep schema conservative and iterate. flip prod-alpha for limited lanes if canary looks ok.
